name: Ashuk and Mashuk
detailed_description:
Ashuk and Mashuk
The curtains rise on an old stage... but this time, horror takes the spotlight.

Ashuk and Mashuk is an atmospheric horror game inspired by cultural folklore. You play as a janitor working in a once-grand theater where the legendary characters Ashuk and Mashuk once performed. What begins as a simple cleaning job slowly turns into a descent into something far more unsettling.

The game unfolds day by day. Each day, you clean a different part of the theater. Each day, something new and strange happens. But cleaning is not your only task—the theater has secrets, and your choices shape the story.

This isn’t a game of dialogue boxes or on-screen decisions. Your actions speak louder: Do you hold onto that strange object? Do you ignore what just moved in the dark? Do you dare finish the job?

With multiple endings influenced by your behavior, no two playthroughs are quite the same. The final curtain depends on you.

Features:

  • A culturally inspired horror experience

  • A day-by-day story progression that blends routine with dread

  • Decision-making through gameplay, not dialogue choices

  • Multiple endings and high replay value

  • Cleaning has never felt so disturbing

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel i3-4170 @ 3.7Ghz OR Intel i5 750 @ 2.67Ghz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia 650TI OR AMD R7 250x
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:

  • Processor: Intel i5 750 @ 2.67Ghz or higher
